notes: Prior vehicle is 'Waterloo Associates SFR Fund II, LP' (Fund II) plus several SMAs/JVs - not a debut manager, but this appears to be only the third institutional-style fund and Fund II performance data (per-project IRRs 13-28%, mix of realized/unrealized) is shown transparently in the deck. This is NOT a typical blind-pool PE/VC fund - it's closer to a structured real estate credit/preferred-equity strategy (target 8% pref, 17%+ cash yield, 80/20 promote, 55% LTC leverage) where the Fund buys land, gets paid down on a pre-committed schedule by homebuilders, and has zero vertical construction risk. Placement-agent fit should weight real estate / real assets / structured credit specialists much more heavily than generalist VC/growth-equity placement agents (the roster used for Global Bioaccess Fund and ISQ InfraTech is a poor starting universe here - built a new, real-estate-focused roster instead). Minimum investment is $10M, which is high relative to the $200M target (implies a small number of large institutional/family-office checks, not a broad retail-style raise) - this should weight toward placement agents with deep institutional/family-office relationships over those specializing in smaller checks.
